quote: “…delay disbursement by up to two quarters…”
body: “Up to two quarters” has no source. Cite the MoF guidance [3] or soften the claim.

quote: “authorise the Minister to agree revised milestones with the World Bank.”
body: Add a deadline for agreeing the milestones so Cabinet can track it.
